import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.scatter(df['Factor'], df['Slope'], color='green', s=50)  # Adjusted marker size for better visibility
plt.title('Scatter Plot: Factor vs. Slope')  # More descriptive title
plt.xlabel('Factor')
plt.ylabel('Slope')
plt.grid(True)
# Chart INFO: {'x_fields': 'Factor', 'y_fields': ['Slope'], 'chart_type': 'scatterChart'}
plt.show()
